standard_event_mapping.description: Segment spec track events mapped to Facebook standard events when the event name matches a recognized standard event. Custom events are forwarded as-is.
standard_event_mapping.fallback: Custom event names are sent as-is to Facebook Conversions API

pii_hashing.description: Facebook requires all PII fields in user_data to be SHA256 hashed, lowercase, trimmed. Both Segment and RudderStack must normalize (lowercase, trim whitespace) before hashing.

hashed_fields.em: SHA256 of lowercase trimmed email address
hashed_fields.ph: SHA256 of phone number (digits only, with country code, no symbols)
hashed_fields.fn: SHA256 of lowercase trimmed first name
hashed_fields.ln: SHA256 of lowercase trimmed last name
hashed_fields.ct: SHA256 of lowercase trimmed city name (no spaces, no special characters)
hashed_fields.st: SHA256 of lowercase two-letter state/province code
hashed_fields.zp: SHA256 of zip/postal code (US: first 5 digits only)
hashed_fields.country: SHA256 of lowercase two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code
hashed_fields.db: SHA256 of date of birth in YYYYMMDD format
hashed_fields.ge: SHA256 of gender (f or m, single character, lowercase)
hashed_fields.external_id: SHA256 of external identifier (userId or anonymousId)

pii_hashing.segment_behavior: Segment hashes PII fields server-side before sending to Facebook Conversions API. Hashing uses SHA256 after lowercasing and trimming.
pii_hashing.rudderstack_behavior: RudderStack Transformer hashes PII fields via destination transform. Same SHA256 + lowercase + trim normalization pipeline.

user_data_field_mapping.description: Mapping from Segment Spec traits/context fields to Facebook user_data parameters

mappings.traits.phone: user_data.ph (SHA256 hashed, digits only with country code)

custom_data_field_mapping.description: Mapping from Segment Spec properties to Facebook custom_data parameters for ecommerce events
custom_data_field_mapping.additional_properties: Any additional properties not matching standard custom_data fields are included as extra key-value pairs in custom_data

mappings.timestamp: event_time (Unix epoch seconds — Segment ISO 8601 string must be converted)

action_source_derivation.description: action_source is derived from context to indicate where the event originated

rules.website: Default for browser-based events (context.library.name contains 'js' or context.page exists)
rules.app: For mobile SDK events (context.device or context.os present without web context)
rules.email: For email-triggered events (if context indicates email source)
rules.system_generated: For server-side events with no client context

page_event_mapping.description: Page calls are mapped to Facebook PageView standard event

identify_event_mapping.description: Identify calls update user_data fields. Some implementations send an identify event to associate user data with the pixel; others skip sending to Facebook entirely.
identify_event_mapping.segment_behavior: Segment may or may not send identify calls to Facebook Pixel depending on configuration. When sent, traits are mapped to user_data fields and hashed.
identify_event_mapping.rudderstack_behavior: RudderStack sends identify calls as a custom event with event_name 'identify' containing hashed user_data. This allows Facebook to associate user identity for future event matching.

known_differences.description: Segment uses messageId directly; RudderStack uses its own messageId format. Both serve as deduplication keys but are generated differently.
known_differences.impact: No functional impact — Facebook uses event_id only for deduplication within the same pixel.

known_differences.description: Derivation logic for action_source may differ between Segment and RudderStack. Both attempt to determine the event origin from context fields, but edge cases may produce different values.
known_differences.impact: Incorrect action_source can affect event quality scoring in Facebook Events Manager. Verify both platforms produce consistent action_source for the same input events.

known_differences.description: Segment hashes userId; RudderStack may hash userId or anonymousId depending on configuration. Both use SHA256 but the input value selection logic may differ.
known_differences.impact: Different external_id hashes prevent Facebook from matching the same user across platforms. Ensure consistent userId selection and hashing.

known_differences.description: Segment may include or exclude additional properties in custom_data based on its Actions mapping configuration. RudderStack includes all non-standard properties by default.
known_differences.impact: Extra properties in custom_data are ignored by Facebook standard event processing but are available in custom reports.

known_differences.description: Both convert to Unix epoch seconds. Segment may truncate sub-second precision differently than RudderStack.
known_differences.impact: No functional impact — Facebook accepts integer epoch seconds.

test_scenarios: Purchase event with full ecommerce properties and all PII fields
ViewContent event with product details and minimal user data
AddToCart event with multiple products in contents array
Custom event (non-standard event name) with arbitrary properties
PageView event from page call with URL and referrer
Identify call with full trait set including address components
Event with fbc and fbp click/browser tracking parameters
Event with only anonymousId (no userId) for external_id hashing
Event with missing optional fields (graceful degradation)

required_settings.accessToken: Facebook Conversions API access token (system user token or generated in Events Manager)

optional_settings.testEventCode: Test event code for validating events in Facebook Events Manager Test Events tool
optional_settings.standardPageCall: Whether to send page calls as PageView events (boolean, default true)
optional_settings.blacklistPiiProperties: Array of property names to exclude from custom_data to prevent PII leakage
optional_settings.whitelistPiiProperties: Array of property names to explicitly include (overrides blacklist)
optional_settings.categoryToContent: Array of mappings from event category values to Facebook content_type values
optional_settings.eventsToEvents: Array of mappings from custom event names to Facebook standard event names
optional_settings.valueFieldIdentifier: Which property to use as value: properties.value or properties.price (default: properties.value)
optional_settings.advancedMapping: Enable advanced matching — send additional hashed user data for improved match rates
optional_settings.limitedDataUse: Enable Limited Data Use for CCPA compliance — restricts data processing geography

notes: Facebook Pixel shared cloud destination. Category: Advertising. Segment has multiple Facebook variants: Facebook Pixel (classic), Facebook Conversions API (Actions), Facebook App Events, Facebook Custom Audiences, and Facebook Personas Audiences. This fixture covers the Facebook Conversions API server-side integration which both platforms use for cloud-mode event delivery. The API endpoint is the same for both platforms (graph.facebook.com/v18.0/{pixel_id}/events). Key parity requirements: (1) identical PII hashing with SHA256 after lowercase+trim normalization, (2) consistent standard event name mapping from Segment Spec to Facebook standard events, (3) matching custom_data field extraction from event properties, (4) consistent action_source derivation from event context. RudderStack destination transform (via Transformer service on port 9090) handles the mapping and PII hashing server-side before delivery.
